elements.name: NMOSFET
elements.description: Three-terminal forward DC square-law NMOS model. id is positive from drain to source. Source must be connected explicitly; body effects are not modeled. Valid for vds >= 0.
equations: id = if(vgs <= VTH, 0, if(vds < vgs - VTH, K * ((vgs - VTH) * vds - vds^2 / 2) * (1 + LAMBDA * vds), K / 2 * (vgs - VTH)^2 * (1 + LAMBDA * vds)))
